agent_task_plan.goal: Revise the saved web-only concept by changing only the Bedroom minimum clear area to 15 m², then generate at least two distinct from-scratch room-position alternatives. Preserve the 10,000 × 8,000 mm footprint, south entrance, existing room keys, all other minimum clear areas and widths, and Kitchen/Bathroom adjacency. Do not inspect or modify Revit or prepare a native build.
successCriteria: Each alternative uses a 10,000 × 8,000 mm footprint with a south entrance.
Bedroom minimum clear area is 15 m² and its minimum clear width remains 3,000 mm.
Preserve bathroom 4 m²/1,800 mm, living_dining 24 m²/4,000 mm, kitchen 8 m²/2,400 mm, and circulation 5 m²/900 mm minimums.
Retain room keys bedroom, bathroom, living_dining, kitchen, and circulation; keep Kitchen and Bathroom adjacent.
Generate at least two distinct re-planned alternatives and summarize their conceptual room dimensions and limitations.
No Revit connection, inspection, modification, or native build preparation.
assumptions: Use the saved concept's current room keys and constraints as the source for unchanged requirements; prior task summaries are not current design evidence.
The saved concept does not establish site conditions, code compliance, or buildability; alternatives remain web-only concepts.

steps.title: Generate first re-planned concept alternative
steps.expectedResult: A measured concept using the preserved footprint, room keys, updated bedroom area and other constraints, with room positions re-planned.

steps.title: Generate a distinct second re-planned alternative
steps.expectedResult: A second measured concept with a materially different room arrangement and the same hard requirements.

steps.title: Compare alternatives and state limitations
steps.expectedResult: Summarize the alternatives and clarify that neither is native-validated or a native-build authorization.
